name: Acceptance vault
description: The acceptance run's own-process plugin: its host half runs in a process of its own, and its `read` command reads the key the user stored for its own `auth` entry with `secrets.get` (answering only the key's SHA-256, never the key), and is refused a name it doesn't list.

auth.help: Any text: the acceptance run's dummy key.

commands.name: read
commands.description: Reads its stored key (its digest only) and a name it doesn't list.
